extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by f(x) as x approaches a.

extracted_concepts.name: One-sided limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit from the left or right side of a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of f(x) as x grows without bound.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit laws
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum, product, and quotient rules for limits.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L, then lim f = L.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity at a point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Removable discontinuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Discontinuity that can be removed by redefining the function at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Horizontal asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line y = L approached as x approaches infinity or negative infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Vertical asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line x = a approached when a function becomes unbounded near a.

extracted_concepts.name: Average rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in output over an interval, equal to the slope of a secant line.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at a single instant, equal to the slope of a tangent line.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence of a derivative at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(x^n) = nx^{n-1}.

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse function derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If y = f(x) and x = g(y), then g'(y) = 1/f'(g(y)).

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-order derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, such as f'', f''', and f^(n).

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, lim f/g = lim f'/g'.

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on [a,b] has an absolute maximum and minimum.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where f' is zero or undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the sign of f' to classify critical points.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses f'' at a critical point to classify local extrema.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Direction of curvature determined by f''.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maximum or minimum values subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of area using rectangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫_a^b f(x)dx = lim Σ f(x_i*)Δx.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects derivatives and definite integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: u-substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Integration method that reverses the chain rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solve dy/dx by integrating separated variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of dy/dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Average value of a function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f_avg = (1/(b-a)) ∫_a^b f(x)dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume of revolution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Volume generated by rotating a region, using discs, washers, or shells.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power series using derivatives at a point.
